note: Promos (P-xxx) do Cardkaizoku (cdn.cardkaizoku.com, 22/10/2026) que não ficavam automáticas, mapeadas como em apps/server/src/card-sources/cardkaizoku.ts, com o texto como o site traz (antes de SOURCE_TEXT_FIXES).

cards.name: Kaido
cards.text: If your opponent has 10 DON!! cards on their field, this Character cannot be K.O.'d.

cards.name: Trafalgar Law
cards.text:
[Blocker]
[On Play] If the number of Don!! cards you have in play is equal to or less than your opponent's Don!! cards, add up to one Don!! from your Don!! deck and set it as rested.

cards.name: Girl
cards.text:
[On Play] Draw 1 card and trash 1 card from your hand.
[Activate: Main][Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your [Nami].

cards.name: Buggy
cards.text:
[Blocker]
[On Play] If you do not have 5 Characteres with a cost of 5 or more, place this Character at the bottom of its owner's deck.

cards.name: Marshall.D.Teach
cards.text: [When Attacking] Negate the effects of all of your opponent's Characters and Leader during this turn.

cards.name: Gol D. Roger
cards.text: [On Play] If you or your opponent have 10 DON!! cards on the field, your Leader gains +2000 power until the end of your opponent's next End Phase.

cards.name: Portgas.D.Ace
cards.text: Blocker. [On Play] Look at 3 cards from the top of your deck and place them at the top or bottom of the deck in any order. Then, give up to 1 rested DON!! card to your Leader or 1 of your Characters.

cards.name: Jewelry Bonney
cards.text: [DON!! x2][Opponent's Turn] This Character gains Blocker and +2000 power.
cards.trigger: K.O. up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 3 or less.

cards.name: Nami
cards.text:
Per the rules of the game, you can only include cards with the {East Blue} type in your deck. ALso, when your deck is reduced to 0, you win the game instead of losing, according to the rules.
[DON!! x1] When this Leader's attack deals damage to your opponent's Life, you may trash 1 card from the top of your deck.

cards.name: Lilith
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Egghead} type, play from your hand up to 1 Character card with a cost of 5 or less that has the {Egghead} type or has a [Trigger].

cards.name: Sanji
cards.text: If your opponent's Life has had a card removed this turn, give this card in your hand -2 cost.

cards.name: Ace & Sabo & Luffy
cards.text: [Activate: Main] [Once Per Turn] Give up to 1 of your {Sabo}, up to 1 of your {Portgas D. Ace}, and up to 1 of your {Monkey D. Luffy} each +2000 power for this turn.

cards.name: Sabo
cards.text: [On Play] You may rest 1 DON!!: Give this Character and up to one of your [Monkey.D.Luffy] and [Portgas.D.Ace] with a base power of 6000 [Rush] during this turn.

cards.name: Portgas.D.Ace
cards.text: [On Play] If you have a character named [Sabo] or [Monkey.D.Luffy] in play, give up to one of your opponent's characters -3000 during this turn.

cards.name: Makino
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to one of your Characters with an original power of 6000 +2000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Garp
cards.text: [On Play] Look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Navy} type card and add it to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. Discard 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy
cards.text: [On Play] You may rest 4 of your DON!!: You may play up to 1 each [Sabo] and [Portgas.D.Ace] from your hand with a power of 6000.

cards.name: Yamato
cards.text: If you have a character in play with no base effect, this character gains +2000 power.

cards.name: Habitual Dine and Dashers
cards.text: [Main] Look at the top 3 cards of your deck; reveal and add up to 1 [Sabo], [Monkey D. Luffy], or [Portgas D. Ace] to your hand. Then, place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order. If you did not add a card to your hand, draw 1 card.

cards.name: Roronoa Zoro
cards.text:
[Rush]
[On Play] Up to 1 of your opponent's Leaders or Characters gain -1000 power during this turn.

cards.name: Kuzan
cards.text: [Your Turn]/[On Play] Play up to 1 Character with [Trigger] and a cost of 1 from your trash.
cards.trigger: Draw 1 card. Then, up to 1 of your opponent's Characters with a cost of 6 or less cannot attack during this turn.

cards.name: Smoker
cards.text: [On Play] If your Leader has the {Navy} type, trash 1 card from your hand and add up to 1 rested DON!! from your DON!! deck. Then, look at 5 cards from the top of your deck; reveal up to 1 {Navy} type card and add it to your hand, and place the rest at the bottom of your deck in any order.

cards.name: Portgas.D.Ace
cards.text: [On Play] Give up to 2 of your opponent's Characters -3000 power until the end of this turn.

cards.name: Monkey.D.Luffy
cards.text: [On K.O.] If your Leader has any given DON!! cards, you may play up to 1 {Straw Hat Crew} type Character card with a power of 6000 or less from your hand.
